english: I enjoy reading books in my free time.
chinese: 我喜欢在空闲时间读书。
soundmark: /aɪ ɪnˈdʒɔɪ ˈriːdɪŋ bʊks ɪn maɪ friː taɪm/

english: He wants to become a doctor.
The man standing there is my uncle.
chinese: 站在那儿的男人是我叔叔。
soundmark: /ðə mæn ˈstændɪŋ ðeər ɪz maɪ ˈʌŋkl/

english: I had my hair cut yesterday.
Seen from the hill, the city looks beautiful.
chinese: 从山上看，这座城市很美。
soundmark: /siːn frɒm ðə hɪl ðə ˈsɪti lʊks ˈbjuːtɪfl/

english: She is always the first to arrive.
soundmark: /ʃiː ɪz ˈɔːlweɪz ðə fɜːrst tuː əˈraɪv/

english: Feeling tired, he went to bed early.
chinese: 感到累了，他很早就睡了。
soundmark: /ˈfiːlɪŋ ˈtaɪərd hiː went tuː bed ˈɜːrli/

english: I regret not studying harder in college.
chinese: 我后悔大学时没有更努力学习。
soundmark: /aɪ rɪˈɡret nɒt ˈstʌdiɪŋ ˈhɑːrdər ɪn ˈkɒlɪdʒ/

english: He stopped to have a rest.
She stopped crying when she saw her mother.
soundmark: /ʃiː stɒpt ˈkraɪɪŋ wen ʃiː sɔː hɜːr ˈmʌðər/

english: It is no use crying over spilt milk.
soundmark: /ɪt ɪz nəʊ juːs ˈkraɪɪŋ ˈəʊvər spɪlt mɪlk/

grammar.label: 固定句型
grammar.text: It is no use doing sth.

english: With so many people helping, we finished quickly.
chinese: 有这么多人帮忙，我们很快就完成了。
soundmark: /wɪð səʊ ˈmeni ˈpiːpl ˈhelpɪŋ wiː ˈfɪnɪʃt ˈkwɪkli/

english: Having finished his homework, he went out to play.
chinese: 做完作业后，他出去玩了。
soundmark: /ˈhævɪŋ ˈfɪnɪʃt hɪz ˈhəʊmwɜːrk hiː went aʊt tuː pleɪ/
